head_commit.message:
draw_range: synthetic shapes only; harness under dev/audit; the 15 % rule pinned; a record without its configuration is dropped whole

- The module docstring, the features block's overbooked shape and the
  evidence harness now use a synthetic overstated nameplate
  (configured 1-10 kW, asked U(3, 10), drawing U(1.2, 1.8)).
- The harness moves to dev/audit/harnesses/ (layout.py's placement
  rule), listed among harness_headers.py's inert reads.
- DrawRange.from_dict drops the samples with an unreadable, absent or
  non-finite configuration, so no reader of samples sees pairs with
  nothing to judge them against.
- Checks pin AGREE_TOLERANCE on both ends and both sides.
- The fold call binds the power-meter freeze on its own line; the class
  is back at main's max_class_loc (8817), so the earlier re-record down
  is returned and tests/structure_budgets.json equals origin/main's.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
